subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

While he stood, in the clutch of his **__adversary__**, he still held his hand on his sword.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"adversary"** means a person, group, or force that opposes or attacks; opponent; enemy; foe. (विरोधी)

 
 
• **Example: **During the debate, he found himself facing his old **adversary** from school.
 
 
 
• **"Helper"** refers to a person who assists or aids another. (सहायक)
 
 
• **Example: **She was my **helper** during the project, always ready to lend a hand whenever needed.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'adversary'** is **'helper'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rival** (प्रतिद्वंद्वी): A person or thing competing with another for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

 
 
• **Example:** She has been my rival since we were in school, always competing for the top spot.
 
 
 
• **Enemy** (शत्रु): A person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The two countries have been enemies for decades, constantly at odds with each other.
 
 
 
• **Foe** (दुश्मन): An enemy or opponent.
 
 
• **Example:** He was a formidable foe in battle, known for his strength and strategy.
 
 

36:Ta7c,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**
